To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

foreign banks in Luxembourg are most efficient if they are focused in their business models, that branches are more efficient than subsidiaries prior to the crisis and that subsidiaries are more efficient than branches during the crisis, but branches diversified in assets and income are more efficient during the crisis than focused branches and subsidiaries.

the optimal business model for foreign banks is a focused strategy, that the most efficient business model for foreign bank branches is a diversified one, and that the optimal business models for bank subsidiaries are a focused asset and income strategy prior to and during, respectively, the financial crisis.
foreign banks’ business model matters for efficiency and that there is no optimal business model that is best for all foreign banks in Luxembourg.
In summary, our research is concerned with
foreign bank efficiency in a financial center, and the results may have policy implications.
the business model of banks and the role of the financial crisis in shaping the most efficient business model.
the optimal business model for foreign banks, which may vary across business dimensions and over time.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single business model that fits all banks.
there are no general rules for foreign bank business models, but that a focused strategy may be preferable to a diversified business model.
there is no optimal business model, but rather that there may be a preferred business model that is contingent on the bank’s organizational form, the business dimensions and the financial crisis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the financial crisis has changed the business model of efficient banks in Luxembourg.
foreign banks in Luxembourg should be more focused prior to the financial crises and more diversified during the crises.
there is no one-size-fits-all model, but rather a set of models that may be optimal depending on the business dimension, organizational form and time.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the business model of foreign banks in a host country may change over time.
there is no optimal business model that fits all banks.
foreign banks’ business models should be adapted to the financial center they operate in.
